Not only will this add a little spark to your East African safari experience, but you’ll also benefit from this:
blocks.html: On this trip you’ll feel as if you’re flying, and that’s because you really are. Short flights replace the long road transfers, carrying you from one highlight of Tanzania to the next. It gives your East African safari an extra spark, and it comes with these advantages as well:

blocks.html: Less of your time goes on travel, so more of it goes on exploring.

blocks.html: From the air, you take in the striking scenery of renowned national parks such as the Serengeti.

blocks.html: No queueing at the gate: board as soon as you reach the airport.

blocks.html: Unwind in plush Diamond Luxury lodges.

blocks.html: We’d be glad to put together your 8-day flying safari for you and alongside you, and we look forward to welcoming you to Tanzania before long.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A question we hear a lot is when Tanzania is best visited. Honestly, there isn’t a single correct answer. It comes down to what you hope to see, where you’d like to travel, your budget and what interests you. You’ll find a detailed guide on the best time to travel to Tanzania here.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: With our Tanzania safaris you get the chance to discover the country’s remarkable wildlife and beautiful scenery. Private safaris are our speciality, so the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is reserved for you and your group alone. You choose when each safari day begins and ends, and on the day itself our experienced guides are happy to help you decide. Perhaps you want to catch the animals when they’re most active around sunrise and sunset, when the temperature is comfortable, or perhaps you’d rather finish the afternoon by the pool; the choice is yours. Because Tanzania’s varied wildlife is active at different times of day, you’ll have many chances to see animals on the move.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is well known as one of the best places to see the Big Five. Lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo can all be watched in their natural surroundings, which is why so many wildlife lovers choose Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a safe and friendly country to travel in. It is a hospitable place, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, and you can enjoy its scenery and wildlife with confidence. People are welcoming, and sensible precautions, like keeping an eye on your belongings, are always wise, just as they would be anywhere else in the world. With its natural beauty and warm-hearted people, Tanzania is a wonderful country to visit.

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide welcomes you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' You’re driven directly to your hotel to rest and soak up the African atmosphere. The following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive, private safari where you set the pace yourself. You have a safari jeep all to yourself, so feel free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you wish!

blocks.orig: The village of Mto wa Mbu is a green oasis in between dry savannah plains, close to Lake Manyara National Park. A tuktuk can take a maximum of 3 people and a tour by tuktuk allows for maximum flexibility. Tuktuks can pass through small streets and can stop anywhere you like. The tour leads past the village itself, then into the forest and past several farms and plantations. In one or two hours you will stop at a brewery, a local artist and a local school.
blocks.html: Close to Lake Manyara National Park, the village of Mto wa Mbu forms a green oasis amid the dry savannah plains. A tuktuk holds up to 3 people, and touring this way gives you as much flexibility as possible. These vehicles fit through narrow lanes and can pull over wherever you want. The route takes you past the village, then into the forest and by several farms and plantations. Over one or two hours you stop at a brewery, a local artist and a local school.

blocks.orig: Discover the Tanzanian way of cooking, smack in the middle of a banana farm. Pick three local dishes and see and learn how they are prepared. Learn to cook pilau (spiced rice), makande (corn and brown beans in a lovely mix) or ndizi nyama (plaintains with meat), and get a taste of Tanzania!
blocks.html: Get to know Tanzanian cooking right in the heart of a banana farm. Choose three local dishes and watch and learn how each one is made. You can learn to prepare pilau (spiced rice), makande (a tasty mix of corn and brown beans) or ndizi nyama (plantains with meat), and get a real taste of Tanzania!

blocks.orig: Lake Manyara National Park is an ideal place for a scenic safari, with landscapes such as acacia woodlands, jungle forests, mountain cliffs, and grassy areas. Its biodiversity makes it home to the amazing tree-climbing lions, but also to a variety of other animal species such as baboons, elephants, buffalos, warthogs, giraffes, wildebeest, zebras, and many more.
blocks.html: For a scenic safari, Lake Manyara National Park is ideal, with acacia woodland, jungle forest, mountain cliffs and grassland. Thanks to this biodiversity it is home to the remarkable tree-climbing lions, as well as many other species, including baboons, elephants, buffalos, warthogs, giraffes, wildebeest, zebras and plenty more.

blocks.orig: Gibb's Farm offers the old-age rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation, right on the slopes of Ngorongoro Highlands. Walk around on this sanctuary of peace and tranquility, and watch vegetables being harvested, coffee roasted, cows milked, and pigs fed. The vegetable gardens, fruit trees, and herbs provide inspiration for the farm's chefs, who in their turn amaze visitors with a delicious lunch. A little piece of heaven!
blocks.html: On the slopes of the Ngorongoro Highlands, Gibb's Farm keeps to the age-old rhythm of an African farm and coffee plantation. Stroll around this peaceful, tranquil sanctuary and see vegetables being picked, coffee roasted, cows milked and pigs fed. The vegetable gardens, fruit trees and herbs inspire the farm's chefs, who then surprise guests with a delicious lunch. A little slice of heaven!

blocks.orig: Today you descend into the wonderous caldera of the famous Ngorongoro Crater. This is THE day to start your game drive early when animals are plenty and tourists few! Feel the little hairs on your arms rise as you descend into the crater, awed by the sight of clouds hovering and the numerous animals in sight. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles, and many more animals can be found here and you are almost guaranteed to see them all.
blocks.html: Today you head down into the wondrous caldera of the well-known Ngorongoro Crater. This is the day to set off on your game drive early, while the animals are many and the tourists are few! As you descend into the crater you’ll feel the hairs on your arms stand up, struck by the clouds hanging overhead and the many animals around you. Coyotes, hyenas, buffaloes, wildebeests, gazelles and plenty of other animals live here, and you are almost certain to see all of them.

blocks.orig: Fly into the mind-blowing beautiful Serengeti National Park for the epitome of safari. See the infamous Big Five in all their glory, and, in certain months, wildebeests running by the thousands in the Great Migration. And even without that; this is big-cat-paradise with prides of lions on kopjes, cheetahs in the long, yellow grass, and leopards in trees. You arrive in time for an amazing afternoon game drive into the sunset.
blocks.html: You fly into the breathtakingly beautiful Serengeti National Park, the very essence of safari. Here you can see the famous Big Five in all their splendour and, in certain months, thousands of wildebeest racing past during the Great Migration. Even without the migration, this is a paradise for big cats, with lion prides on kopjes, cheetahs in the tall yellow grass and leopards up in the trees. You get there in time for a wonderful afternoon game drive into the sunset.

blocks.orig: Anything you can think of when you picture a luxurious safari, you will surely find in Serengeti National Park. Not only the Big Five, the famous Great Migration, and a multitude of big cats, but also rarer species such as the gerenuk or the wild dog, and did we mention the plus 500 species of birds? In between, you naturally spot antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos, and many more animals. Make sure to wake up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!
blocks.html: Whatever comes to mind when you imagine a luxury safari, you’ll find it in Serengeti National Park. There are the Big Five, the famous Great Migration and lots of big cats, but also rarer animals such as the gerenuk and the wild dog, and then there are the more than 500 bird species. Along the way you’ll naturally see antelopes, giraffes, elephants, zebras, hippos and many other animals. Be sure to get up at sunrise for an epic balloon safari...!

blocks.orig: A balloon safari in the iconic Serengeti National Park will make your Tanzania safari a memorable experience. You rise at sunrise and gently fly over the endless plains of the Serengeti. The hot air balloon floats at treetop height above the baobabs and acacias so that you can see the animals nearby. Watching the wildlife below from your balloon is a fascinating and peaceful experience that comes with breathtaking panoramic views.
blocks.html: Taking a balloon safari over the iconic Serengeti National Park turns your Tanzania safari into an experience to remember. You go up at sunrise and drift softly across the endless Serengeti plains. The hot air balloon glides at treetop level over the baobabs and acacias, so the animals are close by. Looking down on the wildlife from the balloon is both captivating and calm, with stunning panoramic views all around.

blocks.orig: After an amazing safari adventure, you take a plane back to Arusha, after which you are transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
blocks.html: Once your safari adventure is over, you fly back to Arusha and are then taken to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) for your international flight home.
